title: A legvidámabb barakk és a gulyáskommunizmus (The Happiest Barrack & Goulash Communism)
grammar: Tacit Compromises, Economic Modality & Macroeconomic Retrospective in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain why Hungary was called the happiest barrack and what goulash communism meant.
I can name features of everyday life in the 1970s, such as the Trabant, the weekend plot and the Balaton holiday.
I can compare Hungary with other socialist countries using words I know.
I can use the infinitive to say what people went to do or could do.
